portTaken: Port {port} is in use too. Choose another.
chooseFolderAgain: Choose the folder again with Choose folder.
onlyFiles: Only files can be dropped here, not folders. Nothing was uploaded.
notAFormat: "{formatId}" is not a format this connection can be handed a file of.
fileNotChosen: That file was not chosen in this app's file picker, so it was not loaded. Choose it again.
notATableFunction: "{functionId}" is not a table function this connection offers.
noKeyPair: {label} does not take a key pair, so a saved account cannot fill it in.
accountGone: That cloud account is no longer saved.
accountNamedProfile: "{name}" is a named profile on this computer, and the ClickHouse server is what reads the data. Use an account saved as an access key, or type the key here.
accountResolved: "{name}" is a credential this computer resolves for itself, and the ClickHouse server is what reads the data. Use an account saved as an access key, or type the key here.
noSecret: "{name}" has no secret in the keychain on this computer.
readOnly: Connection "{label}" is read-only; creating a table is blocked.
cannotWriteFormat: "{formatId}" is not a format this connection can write.
reachNothing: Nothing is listening at {url}. Check Ollama is running there, and that it was started with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 so it accepts connections from other machines.
addrNotResolved: The address {url} could not be resolved. Check the host name.
reachTimeout: {where} did not answer in time. Check the address is right and that a firewall is not blocking the port.
portBlocked: Port {port} cannot be used: the browser engine blocks it. Run the server on another port (Ollama's default is 11434).
certRejected: The certificate at {url} was not accepted. A self-signed certificate has to be trusted by this machine.
workEmail: Enter your work email address, for example you@yourcompany.com.
asmNoString: AWS Secrets Manager: secret "{secretId}" has no string value (binary secrets are not supported).
asmNotJson: AWS Secrets Manager: secret "{secretId}" is not JSON (expected keys like "username" and "password").
asmNotObject: AWS Secrets Manager: secret "{secretId}" is not a JSON object.
asmNoFields: AWS Secrets Manager: secret "{secretId}" has no "username" or "password" field.
asmHostMismatch: AWS Secrets Manager: secret "{secretId}" is for the database at "{host}", but this connection points at "{given}", so its credentials were not sent. Clear the host on the connection to use the secret's, or set it to "{host}".
ssoNone: No single sign-on is set up for {domain}. Check the address, or ask whoever administers your team to connect your identity provider.
ssoUnavailable: Single sign-on is not available for {domain} yet. Ask whoever administers your team to connect your identity provider.
ssoFailed: Could not start single sign-on for {domain}.
cloudSilent: SnoutData Cloud did not answer in time
signInToOpen: Sign in to SnoutData to open this database.
noDbToken: SnoutData did not issue a database token ({status})
netOffline: Could not reach {service}. This computer appears to be offline. Check your internet connection and try again.
netBlocked: Could not reach {service}. Your network, VPN, or firewall may be blocking it. If you are on a company network, this may be restricted by company policy. Try another network, or contact your IT department.
netDown: Could not reach {service}. It may be down or having trouble right now. Try again in a few minutes.
sqliteMissing: {feature} needs its local database, which this build cannot load. Reinstalling the app usually fixes it.
sqlToLogFailed: This SQL can't be auto-translated to a log query ({message}).
sqlToNativeFailed: This SQL can't be auto-translated to a {nativeName} ({message}).
backendNoSql: The '{kind}' backend doesn't support SQL queries yet.
wsNotFound: "{name}" was not found, so it was not imported.
wsLink: "{name}" is a link, so it was not imported. Import the file it points to instead.
wsNotFile: "{name}" is not a regular file, so it was not imported.
noDownload: No {name} download is available for {platform} yet.
termsNotAccepted: Nothing was downloaded: {vendors}'s licence terms have not been accepted.
noticeIbm: IBM's Db2 driver is downloaded from IBM and used under IBM's licence.
noticeSap: The SAP HANA client is downloaded from SAP's package on npm and used under SAP's licence.
notReporting: {source} is not reporting on this server.
orbitFallback: Could not read {source}, falling back to {fallback}. ({error})
notSigned: The downloaded update to v{version} is not signed by SnoutData, so it was not installed. {detail}
sslCa: SSL CA certificate: could not read "{caPath}" ({error}).
terminalUnavailable: The terminal backend could not load, so the agent console is unavailable in this build.
ownKeyPlan: Using your own {provider} key needs a plan that includes your own keys.
addKeyDataGen: Add your {provider} key in Settings, Data Generation.
ollamaMissingModel: The Ollama server does not have "{model}". Pull it there (ollama pull {model}) and run again.
docTooLarge: "{name}" is too large to attach (over {max} MB).
docNoTextScan: No text could be extracted from "{name}". It may be a scanned or image-only PDF (no text layer).
docNoText: No text could be extracted from "{name}".
pageTimeout: The page took too long to render.
pageFailed: The page could not be rendered: {message}
vectorMismatch: This index was built with {built}, and the flow now names {now}. A search embedded with one cannot be compared with vectors from the other. Run the flow once to re-embed, then search.
vectorNoRun: No run of this flow has written vectors yet, so the index may have been built with another model. Searching with {model}.
vectorDims: The model returned {returned}-dimension vectors, and this index holds {held}. The model behind "{model}" has changed; run the flow again to re-embed.
insecureAddress: The sign-in service answered with an address that is not a secure web page, so it was not opened.
notOnFeed: That download is not on our feed yet, so there is nothing here to fetch. Nothing is wrong with this computer or your connection.
signInEmbed: Sign in to embed with SnoutData AI.
uploadNoAnswer: The upload finished but no answer came back in 15 minutes.
noBrowser: No browser is available to render the page.
usersNotSupported: Users and privileges are not supported for this connection.
simplerSelect: Try a simpler SELECT/WHERE/LIMIT, or write it in the Pipeline tab.
plainSelectLogs: Try a plain SELECT over one log scope, with WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY and LIMIT.
noVectors: This flow does not write vectors, so there is nothing to search.
brokenLink: This file is a link to something that does not exist.
linkOutside: This file is a link to somewhere outside the workspace.
linkNoWrite: This file is a link, and the workspace does not write through links.
